    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    start = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)

    # Draw a diagonal toward the marker, then continue parallel to
    # whichever axis still has distance, stopping diagonally adjacent.
    while abs(tr-r) > 1 and abs(tc-c) > 1:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr-r) > 1:
        r += dr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc-c) > 1:
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
",
